dimensions.name: Autonomous orchestration
dimensions.blocker: Runtime, approvals, budgets, research, recommendation polling and fulfillment orchestration are materially stronger, but no complete unattended customer journey yet crosses live payment, canonical website generation and externally verified provider connections; the newest connector wave remains engineering-complete rather than live OAuth-proven.

dimensions.name: Operational reliability
dimensions.blocker: Live use exposed defects that the pre-deploy suite missed, including a dropped intake-track parameter, pre-hydration choice loss and study-image optimization timeouts. Those are fixed and guarded, but backup-restore proof, external 5xx/task-health alarms, edge throttling and whole-company deletion remain incomplete, and the newest main head has no attached hosted workflow run.

dimensions.name: End-to-end customer fulfillment
dimensions.blocker: Build Room v1 now carries approved purchased scope through operator work, evidence, founder actions, verification and handoff, but Build My Website still has no canonical engine adapter and normal live checkout remains parked on the Texas tax registration; no full real founder journey has reached paid verified handoff.

dimensions.name: Premium website-generation capability
dimensions.blocker: The directly relevant Stromation engine remains capable on merged Phase 6-6.6 evidence, but SelfOperate still cannot invoke it. There is no canonical website-generation adapter and no newer merged engine evidence since September 16, so standalone engine quality cannot be scored as integrated Business Builder fulfillment.

dimensions.name: Commercial readiness
dimensions.blocker: The offer model, $395 audit credit, included 30-day Self Operate period, continuation billing path, privacy/terms, supervised release controls and founder-approved email path are implemented, but live Stripe remains deliberately fail-closed until the Texas sales-and-use-tax registration becomes active; counsel review and production proof for the newest merged surface also remain outstanding.

dimensions.name: Customer acquisition readiness
dimensions.blocker: SEO/GEO legibility, offer clarity, package-specific intake and the premium public experience are stronger, but there is still no demonstrated repeatable lead-to-checkout-to-paid funnel. Live payment is unavailable during the tax-registration wait and the website offer cannot yet be fulfilled through the canonical product.

dimensions.name: Business / economic proof
dimensions.blocker: There is still no verified paying SelfOperate/Business Builder customer cohort, recurring revenue, CAC, gross margin, retention or paid-delivery economics. Product and launch-readiness progress do not substitute for economic proof.

changed: The biggest change is that the canonical product now has a real Build Room fulfillment layer from approved purchased scope through operator work, evidence, founder actions, verification and handoff, while package-specific intake, guarded founder-approved email execution and a much broader read-only connector surface were merged. That raises fulfillment, setup/verification and autonomy. The counterweight is meaningful live-regression evidence: the :78 deployment exposed a dropped intake-track parameter that sent customers down the wrong intake, and later live checks caught pre-hydration choice loss and study-image 504s. Those defects are fixed and guarded, but they keep reliability from moving higher. Website generation remains unintegrated and live payment remains parked on the Texas tax registration.
method: Business Builder/SelfOperate-only independent forecast grounded in the 2026-09-21 canonical dariusstrongman/businessbuilder main through the broad read-only connector merge, Build Room fulfillment/handoff implementation, live :78/:82 regression-and-fix evidence, Control Center truth guards and staging-acceptance design, current Stripe/tax-registration state, and only directly relevant Stromation website-engine main. Engineering-complete but externally unverified connectors are credited only as implementation; the latest Business Builder head has no attached hosted workflow-run evidence. Unrelated Stromation ventures, company-wide autonomy and Stromation customer/revenue status are excluded. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.
